function.name: search_knowledge
function.description: Search JOOLA's shared customer-service knowledge (product fit and sizing, eyewear lenses, paddle care, shipping destinations, returns links, paddle registration). Call this for general questions your built-in knowledge does not cover. Not for customer-specific data — use lookup_order for that. Returns { enabled, results: [{ heading, content }] }. If enabled is false or results is empty, answer from your built-in knowledge or offer a follow-up email. Never contradict the warranty policy.

query.description: The customer's question in plain words, e.g. 'do you ship to Vietnam' or 'which lens is best for indoor play'. Do not include names, emails or order numbers.
